about_the_game:
Establish mining operations, refine raw resources, and manufacture advanced goods. Engage in a dynamic and realistic player-driven market, strategically buying low and selling high to accumulate wealth. The ultimate goal? Acquire enough capital to buy out your opponents and claim total monopoly on the new planet.

*Not all graphical assets are final.

Resource Extraction

Mine valuable minerals from the Martian crust to fuel your industrial empire.

Transform those raw resources into complex goods through intricate production lines. Build up your corporation's factories and miners.

Dynamic Economy

Engage in real-time trading with other players, influencing market prices and securing profits.

Advanced Diplomacy

Fight off the other corporations by making deals with the colony, fight to implement laws to battle them in the Mars Trade Committee, or sabotage them with black market actions.

Mars Trade Committee

Elect a committee leader, organise tariffs, vote on good restrictions, bid on colony contracts, and garner votes for important issues.

Auctions!

Bid on all kinds of good stuff, from colony contracts to rake in the revenue, to black market cards to sabotage your enemies.

Black Market

Purchase shady tools or hire shady figures to sabotage your competitors, invest in the destruction of enemy stock price as you blow up factories, cause strikes, and more.

Stocks & Shares

Each corporation has it's own stock price - please shareholders and hold off hostile takeovers by keeping your stock price high. Be careful, you're given a credit rating based off your debt and that credit rating determines your stock price, you'll have to manage your finances carefully.

Unique HQs

Build your own corporation by selecting Company Traits, these define your corporation - it's strengths, it's weaknesses, it's unique talent. Your corporation will be unique. Yours will be the one to conquer the Red Planet.

short_description: Build your company on Mars - where terraforming is profit, dust storms are bankruptcy, and politics controls the air you breathe. An RTS where profit matters - buy shares in other players until you can initiate a hostile takeover. You must rule the markets of Mars, no matter what it takes.
